nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Ultra Facial Oil-Free Cleanser

avis.texte: I absolutely love this cleanser! I have oily, acne-prone skin, and this cleanser just makes my skin feel clean and oil-free when I use it.
Love this stuff, it's the only the only thing that gets ALL my make up off, and leaves my skin squeaky clean, and ready for moisturizer. Doesn't dry me out and has an okay scent.

I purchased this because it was recommended as the replacement for the discontinued oil eliminator cleanser. This is a terrible replacement. The cleanser feels extremely harsh and absolutely strips my face, while also not providing the exfoliation that the oil eliminator did. Very disappointed and will have to look elsewhere for a replacement face wash.
Made for oily or combination skin, I like that there are individual skin types because there is no one product that can be made for all skin types. I purchased it for my boyfriend to try.
Lathers up really nice but very drying. And I do not care for the scent. It is subtle but not for me. Won't buy again.
This is my all time favorite face wash! This makes my face feel clean without feeling dried out. Would recommend this to everyone!

I have really oily skin. This cleanser makes my face feel exactly like those old cleansers that would completely strip your skin of any traces of oil. It leaves my skin feeling uncomfortable… The OG is the way to go.
I've been using this for over 15 years. A little goes a long way. Leaves my face feeling clean and fresh daily. I especially love it after using sunscreen in the summer.
My absolutely favorite cleanser- oil free, deep cleansing, foaming and easy rinse.
I love the oil free cleanser it leaves my face refreshed without over drying and it's good for sensitive skin

I use this oil free cleanser every morning and night. I really like the feel of it on my face. It rinses off cleanly, and makes my face feel fresh. It only takes a little bit to get a great lather on my face.
Light weight and cleanses the skin for layering day or night...Nice and foamy for quick lather....

I have combination skin and this is a great cleanser. Even a plain dove bar soap left my forehead a little oily, but after using this I can apply moisturizer and get the perfect blend of what my skin needs. Nearly fragrance-free, which is also a major plus.

avis.titre: Just a dab and you're all set!
avis.texte: Just as the description says, just a small dab creates a gentle foaming cleanser. Really wonderful.
This product made my face feel like and look like I was 26 again. I love it

avis.titre: This wash now has Salicylic Acid!
avis.texte: This was a staple skin care product for me, but for the past 4 months Ive been dealing with an odd rash around my nose/lips, when to my doc, possible rosacea, doc said to double check my products as well, and long behold.. this wash NOW HAS SALICYLIC ACID. THIS DID NOT BEFORE so beware! I have very sensitive skin, I stopped using this product (2 wks after) and my rash now went away. It'd would've been nice to share that you added a new ingredient... especially one that can dry skin out. I'll missed this wash :-(
Love, love, love this cleanser. It not only removes my makeup, but leaves my face oil free and brilliant looking.
I've been using this cleanser for years now I love how my face feels so clean but not stripped a little goes a long way so you don't need a Lotta product and that's awesome
This was a gift and the recipient loved it. A perfect complement to their cleansing routine.
You only need the smallest amount and it matters into so much. My face has never instantly felt so clean!

Best cleanser. Originally i had a sample bottle roughly 2 oz and it lasted a long timw cause you really only need a little pea sized amount to really get clean. I have combination skin prone to dryness and this doesnt over oil or dry me out.
Decided to try 3/4 years ago and it was the best decision for my face! Lather is great, cleans gently and leaves skin fresh!!

I have been using this as my facial cleanser for over 10 years. I love it. It has a great lather, is super gentle on my skin, and has really helped with breakouts, and a little goes a long way! As long as this stuff is available, I'm going to buy it.
Was looking for a cleanser to remove excess oil on my forehead. This is best so far.
I love this cleanser! I have combination skin and it is perfect for everyday use. I use it twice a day and my skin is not dried out.

avis.titre: The best face cleanser for oily skin
avis.texte: For years I had normal/combination skin, but within the last couple years I started having noticeably oily skin, with breakouts focused around my chin. nothing I tried seemed to be helping it. After some research, I decided on this cleanser and it is the best decision I have made for my skin. It has helped my skin be significantly less oily (less breakouts) and a little bit of the product lathers nicely so it goes a long way.

avis.titre: Mediocre product. There are better ones available.
avis.texte: It's okay. Doesn't handle oily skin as well as I would have thought given the marketing language attached to this product. I would not purchase again.
Love the lightness and softness of the face wash. My face feels clean and not an overly strong scent
Extremely drying face wash. Gets the makeup off but left my face extremely dry

avis.titre: Fave cleanser for the last few years!
avis.texte: I'm obsessed with this cleanser. It feels hydrating and moisturizing and it also removes removes makeup nicely. I have combination skin and love that that it is oil free and doesn't dry out skin.
the person using the product tells me it makes their skin glow & helped reduce the oil in his face.
I believe this is actually drying my face. Now I need to put on a moisturizer in places on my face where I never needed it.

They changed the cap and I don't know if I will buy this product anymore because of that. Now if you take the cap off, you can't get it back on and you WASTE a ton of product trying to get it out when the bottle gets towards empty.
Feels great after wash. Really feels like oil has been removed.
Great face cleanser! It's my go to product and I would highly recommend it. Great cleaning without stripping your face dry.
Does not give me a clean feeling. It feels like there is a film of residue on my skin.

avis.titre: A key to living a century and still looking good
avis.texte: This is a fantastic product. As a male who wants to be a centenarian my feeling is that this "soap" cleanses my face, but more importantly helps keep my skin pores small which is an skin issue for older males.

This is a great example of a light cleanser that doesn't sit heavy on the face and is easy to use. It smells clean and is white cream, a little goes a long way. I used in the shower to clease and message my face while shampooing. It worked quite well.
I have combination skin, oiliest in T zone, this is the cleanser for me. I've tried many others and I always comeback to this one.

I am 68 and still have complexion issues. I've used lots of products , some very expensive well known brands. I'm very pleased with the results I'm getting with this cleanser and the tube lasts many months. Minimal amount cleans well.
I've been using this for about two years now. I cannot use anything else.

avis.titre: Worth a try for oily skin
avis.texte: I have OILY skin in the summer, and pretty normal skin the rest of the year. I have used this for about 2 weeks now and it has made quite the difference in my ACNE PRONE, OILY skin. During the summer, I go from an occasional break out to a severe case of moderate acne--lots of whiteheads and a handful of nodules (the big painful ones that appear under your skin). I used this twice a day (morning and night) and it has done its part to control the acne and treat it. TBH, I am thoroughly surprised it did as much as it does. I am going to keep using this for the summer and probably switch it out for the fall, but come back for it once the temperatures increase again. My general routine with this product: Cleanse Occasional exfoliator Toner Serum Moisturizer
I have been using this face wash for two weeks now and my blackheads and oily t-zone have gone away!

pros: no scent, a little goes a long way, & my face feels very soft the next day. cons: kind of hard to wash off, makes my face feel tight/stripped, and it doesn't wash away everything. i would recommend double cleansing, followed by a good moisturizer.

I've been using this face wash for a year now and i can safely say its the best one I've used. I've struggled with really oily skin, especially in my T zone, for a long time and since using this I've no longer needed to use powder to matte my face. My skin is SO soft and the cleanser is super gentle on the skin; it feels amazing. I get compliments on my skin a lot.

avis.titre: Please read if the list below resonate with you
avis.texte: Key words/issues: •combination skin •very oily skin in summer •hormonal breakouts •large pores •blackheads •nothing else is working After constantly switching cleansers because nothing combated my breakouts, I was determined to find the "perfect" cleanser for my skin. I have tried everything from luxury to drug store cleansers: Kate Somerville, Dermalogica, Murad, Cetaphil, Mario Badescu, and Clean and Clear. Nothing worked as good as Kiehls cleanser. I have combination skin that is very oily in the summer and dry patches in the winter. The cleanser can feel like it is stripping your skin but if you have large pores, blackheads, and hormonal breakouts, it is worth it to combat the issues. My pores feel "cleaned" out. I have been using it for 4 weeks and my skin became more clear every day I used it. I no longer have weekly breakouts. I follow the cleanser with Clinique moisturizer and I only use the cleanser once a day. I recommend this product if you have any of the following issues listed above.

avis.titre: Best facial cleanser for oily face
avis.texte: Finally find a great facial cleanser product! Everyone with oily face should tries this!

I bought this product after trying the Calendula Gel Deep Cleanser. I started breaking out and experiencing some adult acne (ugh) and the Calendula cleanser didn't seem to clean deep enough in order to prevent breakouts. This product leaves my skin feeling cleaner without completely stripping it and my breakouts have become less. It can be a bit harsh to use twice daily, depending on your skin type and your exposure in the environment. Sometimes I will alternate between this and the Calendula product if I don't need a super deep cleanse.

avis.titre: Great daily cleanser for sensitive/acne prone skin
avis.texte: I tried some samples of this after buying another Khiel's product and thought it was great! It is an oil free cleanser that works well with acne prone skin as well as sensitive skin. It did not make me break out at all. It is unscented, and makes a very rich and foamy lather that is compatible for cleansing with a foreo luna, or any other silicone brush. Rinses off to a very squeaky clean. This stuff works well. Would recommend and will probably buy a full size one.

I use this as first step of my double cleanse at night. I love how little I can use and how much foam still comes from it. this product will last me very long. it cleanses but doesn't make my face feel dry at all.

This is the best. I have oily skin and large pores but this helps with both of those problems. I've tried hundreds of face washes and nothing compares to this. It almost feels like you exfoliated but without the harsh feeling.

I have always had oily skin, especially around the T-zone area. This cleanser saved my life and significantly reduced the oily look on my face. It is also a very clean product & has no artificial fragrances or harmful ingredients. Works super well for sensitive skin and does not dry the skin out either. LOVE THIS!

A neighbor recommeded this product when the prior product I used was discontinued by a different company. I was a bit skeptical because I have sensitive skin that can breakout from products. Kiehl's Ultra Facial Oil-Free cleanser works exceptionally well. It cleans my face with no residue and it doesn't dry my skin out. My face looks smooth and healthy. I'm online to reorder now. Thought I'd leave a review for anyone with sensitive skin who wonders if this product may work for them.
I like how well this cleanser lathers. A little goes a long way with this one. It help clear those tiny bumps you often get in your T-zone. My skin looks & feels clean after about 2 weeks of use.
I love this face wash. It goes on smooth, and it leaves my super-oily skin feeling firm and not slick at all when I get out of the shower.
This is about my favorite cleanser. It makes your face feel really clean without drying it. I love using this product.

I loveeee this cleanser! I have semi-oily skin so it cleanses it just enough without stripping me of my oils I need to stay hydrated. It goes such a long ways too, one bottle lasts me months. I love that it has no scent, fragrance always breaks me out. It cuts right through my makeup and leaves my skin very clean. I use it morning and night. Oh and it foams up to such a great lather. I can't imagine ever using another cleanser again.

After a many-year search, I finally discovered this non-paraben, wonderful facial cleanser. Have used it for two years and love it. Consistency is great, even in the shower, and my face feels really clean after using. Really clean, but soft and not at all sticky, dry, oily, or irritated. Please don?t ever stop making this!!

I had annoying white bumps on my nose forever. With really sensitive skin, most oil free face washes were too harsh for me and made my skin horribly red and irritated. This is the ONLY product after many many tries that has helped! You use such a minimal amount of product, so this has seriously lasted me for so long. Completely worth every penny!!!

This cleanser is amazing for normal to oily skin type. So for the 1 star below, know your skin type! This is not for sensitive or dry skin. Amazing product, only need a pea size amount so this size lasted me an entire year using twice a day. That is very rare to find.

I really love how this cleanser helps reduce the amount of oiliness on my skin. I also love how it?s not too harsh for my sensitive skin and doesn?t irritate my skin like most other cleansers do. This is probably the best cleanser I?ve used for my sensitive/oily prone skin. 100% recommend.

avis.titre: Awesome but need a travel size
avis.texte: I love this stuff! It is so gentle, effective, non-drying and lasts forever. It doesn?t break me out or make me feel super dry. I only wish it came in a travel size. PLEASE MAKE A TRAVEL SIZE!

I also received this product as a sample and have now purchased the full size. Small amount needed to lather whole face and I can use it to take my makeup off as well. I have a lot of trouble finding facial products because of my acne prone, red, oily skin and I also struggle with psoriasis. This cleanser is one of the only products I've found to clean my face well, not cause a breakout, and also not add to my redness. It is great.

Omg, I simply love, love, love this product. It leaves my skin feeling fresh and smooth every single time I use it. I don?t feel the cakes on oil that I would always feel before. It?s a miracle in a bottle!!!

avis.titre: This SUCKS. My skin is even worse than before I started use.
avis.texte: Never use this people, burns your skin, gives you plenty of rashes so don't use for sensitive skin

I received this cleanser in one of my monthly box. It is amazing. You use about a pea size amount and it just grows and grows. It truly saves you so much money because it last so long. It goes on super creamy but rinses off super clean feeling. Trust me it is worth every cent. Run don't walk to purchase. My daughter and her husband use it to. I accidentally left my tube at their house after a visit and they fell in love with it they purchased it too.

at first i bought the Ultra Facial Oil-Free Moisturizer and later decided to buy the cleanser. This cleanser has made my face so soft and a little goes a long way. Love that its not harsh on the skin! most products i have tried will make me breakout but not this, my skin has never looked better!

If you suffer from overly oily skin like I do, this is your savior! This cleanser eliminates all the oils from your skin and leaves it squeaky clean! I consider this my favorite Kiehl's product and would recommend to anyone that has excessively oily or combination skin. Use with Oil free hydrating gel moisturizer for a fresh and clean feeling.

This is the most gentle cream cleanser which is good if you have oily/sensitive skin like I do. I've used this for years and I'll venture out to new cleansers but I always come back to old reliable. I definitely recommend this cleanser. It's gentle and it's non drying. So, if you're in the market for something different that won't irritate your skin, try this.

I am a 55 year old female with skin that varies depending on the time of year and conditions. I switch out between this and other Kiehl's cleansers, depending on how my oily my face is on that day. This product lathers well, and really doesn't take much to get the job done. Over all I like it, but sometimes it can be drying, that is why I am only giving it 4 stars.
It's my favorite of all Kiehl's products. Cleans every bit of makeup off my face and my skin feels smooth after. Great for my slightly oily skin.

This is my go to cleanser! I've had sensitive skin my whole life. I easily break out and have oily yet dry skin. This cleanser keeps everything under control and leaves my skin feeling fresh and soft. I noticed a huge difference when I forgot to bring it on a vacation. I HIGHLY recommend this cleanser.

avis.titre: The only cleanser I will ever use again!
avis.texte: I have been using this product for over two years now. I have combination skin with a very oily T zone that's prone to acne and have tried multiple cleansers over the years. I always had the same problem with other cleansers, they would work for maybe six months then my skin would start breaking out again. Since I started using this cleanser two years ago the only time I've seen the slightest sign of acne was when I was being lazy and not staying on top of my routine, definitely not the cleansers fault. It removes all the excess oil and I apply moisturizer right after and my skin always feels and looks great. This will be a staple of my skin care routine for as long as Kiehl's makes it.

avis.titre: Cleared my blackheads in less than a week. a toner and a ...
avis.texte: Cleared my blackheads in less than a week. I use it in the morning, then I use a toner and a moisturizer and at night the same thing. My skin is oily and sensitive and by being oily I've got blackheads in and around my nose area. This has improved my blackheads absence I would say a 65% in like 3-4 days of using it day and night. It makes my skin oil controlled so much that when I moisturize it doesn't get oily again, it doesn't hurt my skin. It's a little annoying when it gets on the eyes that's the only bad thing. The texture is amazing and a little goes a long way, which for the price it makes justice.

Not my thing at all! If you like cleansers that smell like vintage soap and leaves a waxy, tight feeling on your face then don't buy this cleanser. Unfortunately I didn't think to get a trial of this product before I purchased :( Can understand it work for some people but just not my cup of tea :)

I like the way the Ultra Facial Oil Free Cleanser feels on my skin. I think that it actually cleans my face without feeling like its over drying my skin like other cleansers tend to do. I love how this controls the oil on my skin. It's great. I have sensitive skin that used to be very acne prone. I use this line to control my surface oil to prevent acne from forming. 100% suggest this to those who have adult acne and want to control oil.

avis.titre: superb facial cleanser for sensitive combination skin wit...
avis.texte: Ultra Facial Oil Free Cleanser truly cleans your face without over drying like many oil free cleansers. I have very sensitive combination skin with very oily t-zone and dry every where else. I struggle with mild adult acne, blackheads/whiteheads on my nose & cheeks. Finding the right cleanser that won't irritate/break me out, won't make me oily or won't dry out my skin has been super challenging. This one is the winner. Within 2 days I noticed how clear & clean my face looks. After using the cleanser, I can see all the dirt stuck in my enlarge pores purging out. My skin has improved in 2 days! Also, tiny amount goes a long way. It's lathers quickly. I use the Ultra Facial Oil Free Toner & Moisturizer as well. The toner gives it an extra cleaning, it's calming & moisturizing. The Moisturizer is light, refreshing, and my face feels dewy & moisturized. LOVE!

The first uses yielded big results, then it was more average, but I still love the product. It removes excess oil very well. Looks like it even tightens pores a little bit. I think it has a great value too.
This cleanser changed the way my skin looked and felt almost immediately! I love that it doesn't dry me out or add oil that I don't need! It provides the perfect balance for me!

I give it four stars cause it has a weird smell but tolerable. I started with a sample and later I made a purchase of the full-size product. It only requires a tiny amount to create a large amount of foam. After rinsing with water, it leaves a very clean feeling but my skin kinda tighten when I pad dry with a towel.

avis.titre: BEST Face Wash of My Adult Life
avis.texte: Yes, I am only 26 but I have searched years for something for my ever so complex combination skin. Dry on my temples, oily in my T-zone, occasionally dry on my cheeks but oily by the end of the day all over. If you have combination skin, just buy this. You use a drop of, it lathers so well and leaves your skin completely clean feeling without over drying like other OTC cleansers do. Bought the toner and moisturizer too and after 1 week people were complimenting me on how clear, even, and healthy my skin looked. I'm never going back. Thank you Kiehl's!

I have combination skin and have never found a cleanser that did not leave parts of my face too dry or too oily. This cleanser does not. My face feel really clean and my t zone is not left feeling oily and the rest of my face is not left feeling dry. You don't need much to get a good lather either. Great product!
Cleans, but leaves behind a waxy film on my skin. That is a deal breaker.

avis.titre: Great face wash for oily skin
avis.texte: I've always had issues finding the perfect face wash for my oily skin. This is the only one that really works and I have been using it for several years since I first started.

avis.titre: It costs a little more but you use your face everyday.
avis.texte: I have normal to oily skin and take a low maintenance approach to skincare. I cleanse and I moisturize. I've used the same common store brand for the past 12 years. I am a 36-year old man. Determined to keep my good skin, I decided to visit a Kiehl's store and add a couple steps to my regimen and find tailored products for me and some preventive care. It's silly to say, but I get excited to use this face cleaner and the new subsequent steps I take. This stuff is legit. My face gets squeaky clean in a non-stripped, resilient kind of way. It doesn't take very much product in your hand, this tube should last at least 3 months.

I have oily skin, and I often struggle with finding a balance between all my products - particularly during those ultra-humid East Coast summers. I'm not a big fan of cleansers made for people with oily skin, as they often work too hard to strip oil away (sacrificing overall skin health in the name of perceived effectiveness# or don't actually do anything at all. This cleanser gently cleans without stripping, is a perfect daily #or twice daily) cleanser, and gets the job done without promising to do anything remarkable. It works better than most products on the market geared towards people with oily skin, and it succeeds in it's simplicity. Those with oily skin should not avoid products that contain oil - that can result in your face producing more oil to compensate. What's good about this product is that it thoroughly cleanses your face without introducing additional oil to your skin. Save the oil for products that should contain a bit: perhaps a moisturizer or an overnight treatment. Highly recommended!

I went into the store to stock up on deodorant and got this as a sample. Tried it and fell in love at first use. Love the lather, (you only need a small amount), my skin looks clear, moisturized and healthy, not dried out a lot of oil free cleansers tend to make you look. I also use it with the toner, great combo. Very pleased!!

avis.titre: best facial cleanser for oily skin!
avis.texte: This is my favorite facial cleanser. It makes my face feel so clean, and almost that refreshing "tighness" without creating dryness. This is a feeling I personally love; having super oily skin, my face never truly feels clean. Would recommend without hesitation.
Great product. It leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed. It definitely isn't too harsh on my sensitive skin, but takes away the oil.

I have very sensitive, acne prone skin, and have tried EVERYTHING. The Ultra Facial Oil-Free Cleanser is the first product I've used that has improved my skin without drying it out. Upon making another purchase at a Kiehl's store, the sales associate gave me some samples of the Ultra Facial Oil-Free line, and my skin was almost clear within three days! It's an added bonus that these products are all fragrance free!

avis.titre: Best for Oily and sensitive skin
avis.texte: This is the best product I have used for my oily skin as it does not dry it out. I also have sensitive skin and it does not break me out. I use very little amount so it will last. It feels like I am getting a facial each morning. It cleanses out my pores and does not leave residue or leave makeup like my other cleanser.
I love this cleanser. I've been using it for a month and have noticed a difference. My face is not as oily as it used to be. A little goes a long way so the tube should last a long time.

For some time I was having difficulty with my skin, either it was too dry or extremely oily. For years I was covering my face in products that would strip my skin of its nutrients and leave it worse off than it already was. There was no improvement. Then last fall, when I was visiting friends, one of the guys told my sister and I about this product. His skin was impecable, so I decided to give it a try. I was told Kiehl's had a really good reputation. and what do ya know, I noticed an immediate difference and have been using this product since then. I dont have issues with too dry or too oily skin anymore and don't feel like I need to wash my face 4-6 times a day. I look and feel healthy now. I don't feel like I need some heavy duty facial to drastically change the look of my skin. This face wash is amazing and I would recommend it to anyone. I've even started adopting more products from Kiehl's and can only say good things about them. :)

I've been using this product for over a year now and I'm still so happy to have finally found a cleanser that works well with my skin. I've tried many drugstore and brand name products in various price ranges and Kiehl's Oil-Free Cleanser has been the most effective for cleansing my oily skin and the most cost-effective (a pea-sized amount will go a long way). Paired with my electronic skin cleanser, this face wash has done very well to help keep my breakouts at bay. I'll be in my thirties soon and I have the best complexion I've had since starting any skincare regimen and I credit that to using this cleanser.
it really works for oily face. I use Egypt magic cream at night, and use it for the next day morning. It do cleans very well.

I am a huge fan of this cleanser! Finally, I've found a cleanser that works well with my oily skin. It's very gentle yet it cleans well. My skin has gotten better ever since using this product. I would never use a different cleanser again. A little goes a looooooong way. I can't even recall when I bought my current bottle and it is still half full. Great value!

I got a deluxe sample of this product. The texture of the cream is silky and creamy. However, after i use it, my skin is extremely dry and looks terrible! it cleans well though. I think I should use it in summer.
After using this product for about 5 days my face was noticeably softer.

I've been using Ultra Facial Cleanser for a long time but after I started using this one, I feel even better. I feel more cleaner and skin feels so fresh. I use lot of make up for my job so end of the day, my skin gets so irritated but after I wash everything off with this product, my skin is ready for Ultra Facial Toner!!

I love all Kiehls products, except this one. I find that it leaves a film on your face. I tried it several times and just couldn't get past the residue it left behind. This is one product that I will not be purchasing again.

I like this cleanser because it's oilfree!! I helps remove all excess oil from your face!!! It feels sooo clean and sooo clear everytime after use!!! It forms quickly and just couple drops will be enough for the entire face!! Definitely recommend to people who have oily skin or acne problems like I do!!! (Maybe a bit dry for winter for dry skin ppl)

I bought this cleanser as a gift for my boyfriend. It's his first time using any type of cleanser so I wanted to get him something that was easy to use and does the job of cleansing. He absolutely loved the product! Every now and then I would use it too and I love the product as well. I really like the squeaky clean feeling! It makes my face feel clean and refreshed from night build ups and etc. I would definitely recommend this product.

This is hands down the best facial cleanser on the market for oily and normal skin. I love that you only need to use a small pea size to lather up your entire face and neck. Your face feels very clean, smooth, not dry or oily once you rinse away. It's perfect!

The small amount of this awesome facial cleanser that I use each time yields a remarkable amount of lather! I use it twice a day and am not even through 1/2 of the tube after 7 months. AND it works really well; leaves my [oily, especially-gross-during-the-just-finished-summer-months-in-Chicago] skin feeling and looking clean. While my skin does not feel tight or dry it does feel like it has a finish of sorts on it. Not harsh and most definitely helpful!

This cleanser is by far the best I've ever tried! I have extremely oily and acne-prone skin that is also sensitive, which has always made it so difficult finding products that work. This cleanser balances out my skin beautifully and as much as I might feel I want to stray and try other cleansers, I always come back to this one. Now I don't even have the tendency to stray. So happy with this one!

I have oily to normal skin and this cleanser leaves me feeling refreshed and very clean without ANY oiliness on my face. Just a tiny bit lathers into enough to clean my face. One tube can last over half a year.

This cleanser by far meets my needs and then some. It has been the best cleanser performance and value wise. Not only does it clean deep into my skin and give me that squeaky clean feeling I absolutely love, the price for the amount it lasts is great! I purchased this bottle the summer of 2011 and I am just now running out. This cleanser does everything I need it to do. I have oily skin and very large pores and this just takes all the dirt and impurities out of my face and leaves my skin bright and smooth. I adore this product and will be purchasing another bottle.

I tried this on a whim after a post-waxing breakout that just wouldn't go away. My skin usually becomes irritated by most cleansers and I was nearly at my wit's end. I am so happy I decided to give this a try! Not only does it last forever (I'm about 3/4 through the bottle and I bought it in May), it has helped my skin clear significantly. My face always feels clean and fresh without feeling dry or tight.
I only use a pea size amount and the product lathers better than any other face wash I've ever used. Cleans exceptionally well without drying my skin.

This is the best facial cleanser I've ever used. I have pretty oily skin -- the type that needs to be wiped off around the forehead, nose, and chin several times a day -- and after the first wash with this cleanser, I saw an immediate difference. My skin is noticeably less oily (I would even go so far as to say NOT oily anymore), more balanced, softer, and just looks better in general. The soft foaming lather is also great and luxurious and a little goes a long way, so this product will last a long time. Love it.

I chose this cleanser to use when I'm not using the Facial Fuel cleanser, which I also love. This one has sort of the opposite result but in a good way. The Facial Fuel can sometimes be a bit harsh on my face with the menthol and caffeine. This one gives me the same amount of clean but without the harshness. I use this primarily at night when I'm trying to wind down. Works just right!

After much research I decided to purchase the oil-free cleanser for my spring/summer regimen. I normally use the ultra for all skin types line and decided to get the oil free for some blackheads on my nose. Well, the blackheads are just about gone and I am very pleased with the product. You will not be disappointed.

When I first found kiehls a couple years ago, this line was not out. It seems as if my prayers were answered when they came out with an oil free line. This cleanser does the trick of cleaning deeply, balancing the skin, and not leaving it with that stripped of natural oils feeling. I have purchased this many times and will continue to. PLEASE DON'T EVER DISCONTINUE THIS!!!

I have combination skin and am very sensitive to oily products, so much so that I will get clogged pores after using them once or twice. The Ultra Facial Oil-Free cleanser was recommended to me by a Kiehls representative, and I love it! My face feels clean and fresh afterward, and best of all, no breakouts!
Being acne prone, I've tried nearly every face wash out there. This is a great one. I love how it foams and doesn't dry my skin out. Overall, a great product.

I love this cleanser, I have oily tzone, acne proned skin. I'm in my 30's so I have tried lots of brands but this one is just amazing. Cleanses my skin and doesn't leave it tight like most cleanser do. I have been using this product for over 3 weeks and I love it, my skin looks so much better.

This is one amazing cleanser...it's like a high-powered swiffer for your face. I don't really need to use a toner to get the rest of my makeup off....this cleanser gets the job done and keeps my breakouts at bay. Plus, my face used to get shiny in the T-zone during the day and that stopped as well (I also use the Gel-Cream). I've tried loads of products in all price ranges and nothing remotely compares to the performance of the Ultra Facial Oil-Free Cleanser.

I tried this cleanser for the first time yesterday and OMG! I don't think my face has ever been this clean before. I have combination/oily skin and have used tons of different cleansers looking for just the right one to deep clean my pores and remove excess oil. This is the one! After using Ultra Facial oil-free cleanser my skin was so soft and perfectly clean. This cleanser doesn't strip my skin of oil or leave a tight, dry feeling which often leads to even more oil. It feels balanced and clean. I follow up with the Sodium PCA oil-free moisturizer which I also love and my skin has never felt better. The next thing I'm eager to try is a Kiehl's toner. I am so addicted to Kiehl's!

avis.texte: This is the best facial cleanser I've ever used and I've used several well known name brands. I've been using this cleanser consistently for the past 4 months and my skin has never looked better. I use it along with the Ultra Facial Oil Free Toner and Moisturizer to complete the regimen. Fabulous! I recently incorporated additional treatments for my night time regimen. AWESOME! Kiehls Rocks! I'm totally hooked...a Kiehls loyalist.
